name: assetpanda/integration-titlebar
title: AP Integration Titlebar
description: Slim sticky title bar for an integration detail page: the partner logo + Asset Panda PRO mark beside the eyebrow and page title. Slides in under the site header once the hero's H1 has left the viewport (Figma 'Sticky Title Bar', 7333:171865). Place it right after integration-hero. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
